name: getresuid
description: getresuid() returns the real UID, the effective UID, and the saved set-user-ID of the calling process. getresgid() performs the analogous task for the process's group IDs.

parameters.name: ruid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the real user ID

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the effective user ID

parameters.name: suid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the saved set-user-ID

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: One of the arguments specified an address outside the calling program’s address space
